Back to projectsLet’s Talk ↗
About the project

The H Hotel Reception Lobby is a contemporary interior design intended to establish a refined hospitality arrival experience in El Nido, Palawan. The double-height arrival space is defined by large-format stone walls, wood ceiling cladding, vertical garden features, and custom-designed reception counters. Layered lighting; including suspended halo chandeliers and accent pendants; enhances the spatial volume while highlighting key architectural features. The material palette combines natural stone, timber finishes, exposed concrete, and integrated greenery to balance elegance and comfort with a direct connection to nature. Spatial organization prioritizes clear circulation from entry to reception, while biophilic elements and warm material tones create a welcoming environment suited to the resort character of the site.
